args.query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(*) AS failed_count, MAX(p.created_at) AS latest
FROM payments p
JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id
WHERE p.status = 'failed'
  AND p.created_at >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00'
  AND p.created_at < '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY c.id

       p.amount_cents, p.status AS payment_status, p.created_at

LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.id = t.linked_payment_id
LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.status = 'open' AND t.title LIKE 'Refund request%'
ORDER BY t.id

args.query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(p.amount_cents) AS spend_cents, COUNT(t.id) AS open_tickets
FROM customers c
JOIN payments p ON p.customer_id = c.id
  AND p.status = 'succeeded'
  AND p.created_at >= '2026-01-01'
  AND p.created_at <= '2026-03-31 23:59:59'
LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.customer_id = c.id AND t.status = 'open'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING spend_cents >= 10000 AND open_tickets >= 1
ORDER BY spend_cents DESC;
